blocks.prompt: 1 (a) Junaid covers 100 km in the first 2 hours, stops for 1 hour, and then drives 60 km in the next 2 hours. The displacement-time graph is shown in Figure 7.9. What is Junaid's average velocity?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh average velocity ka sawal hai, aur safar teen hisson (phases) mein hai: chalna, rukna, phir chalna.
Diya kya hai? Har phase ka faasla aur waqt: 100 km 2 ghante mein, 1 ghanta ruka, phir 60 km 2 ghante mein.
Find kya karna hai? Poore safar ki average velocity.
Rule: average velocity = total displacement / total time.
Plan: pehle total displacement, phir total time (rukne ka waqt bhi shamil), phir divide.
steps:
Diya gaya: 2 h mein 100 km, 1 h ka stop, phir 2 h mein 60 km; Junaid hamesha ek hi direction mein chalta hai.
Maloom karna: poore safar ki average velocity.
Tareeqa: \(v_{avg} = \frac{\text{total displacement}}{\text{total time}}\) (7.1.3). Kyunke Junaid kabhi wapas nahi mudta, is liye har phase ka displacement seedha jama ho jata hai, aur yahan distance aur displacement barabar hain.

Graph ke kone wale points
\[O(0, 0),\ A(2, 100)\]
\[B(3, 100),\ C(5, 160)\]
Kyun: 2 ghante baad woh start se 100 km door hai (point A). Stop ke ek ghante mein position nahi badalti, \(x\) 100 hi rehta hai (point B, \(t = 3\)). Aakhri 2 ghanton mein 60 km aur, to \(t = 2 + 1 + 2 = 5\) par \(x = 160\) (point C).

Total displacement
\[\Delta x = 160 - 0\]
\[= 160\text{ km}\]
Kyun: displacement ka matlab hai aakhri position minus pehli position. Yahan yeh 100 + 0 + 60 ke barabar hai, kyunke stop ke dauran displacement zero tha.

Total time
\[\Delta t = 2 + 1 + 2\]
\[= 5\text{ h}\]
Kyun: jab Junaid ruka hua tha tab bhi ghari chal rahi thi, is liye stop ka 1 ghanta bhi total time ka hissa hai.
Dhyan dein: bahut se students sirf chalne ka waqt (4 h) lete hain aur \(160/4 = 40\) km/h likh dete hain. Yeh ghalat hai; average hamesha poore waqt par nikalti hai.

Average velocity
\[v_{avg} = \dfrac{\Delta x}{\Delta t} = \dfrac{160}{5}\]
\[= 32\text{ km/h}\]
Kyun: average velocity ki definition mein yahi do cheezein divide hoti hain. Matlab yeh ke agar Junaid poore 5 ghante ek jaisi raftaar se chalta to 32 km/h se chal kar bhi wahin pohanchta.

Tasdeeq: OC ka slope
\[\dfrac{160 - 0}{5 - 0} = 32 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: displacement-time graph par pehle aur aakhri point ko seedhi line se jorein to us line ka slope hi average velocity hota hai. Dono tareeqon se 32 aaya, to jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 7.9 sawal ke alfaaz se match nahi karti. Figure mein aakhri seedha hissa \(t = 3\) h se \(t = 6\) h tak hai, yani 60 km teen ghanton mein, jabke sawal saaf kehta hai ke agle 2 ghanton mein 60 km. Hum sawal ke alfaaz ko follow karte hain: aakhri phase \(t = 5\) h par \(x = 160\) km par khatam hota hai, jaisa hamari Figure 7.9 mein hai. (Agar koi printed figure se parhe to jawab (a) mein \(160/6 \approx 26.67\) km/h aur (b) mein \(60/3 = 20\) km/h aate; exam mein sawal ke alfaaz hi asal data hain.)

blocks.prompt: 1 (b) Junaid covers 100 km in the first 2 hours, stops for 1 hour, and then drives 60 km in the next 2 hours. The displacement-time graph is shown in Figure 7.9. What is his velocity during the last phase of the journey?
blocks.explanation:
Is part mein poore safar ki nahi, sirf aakhri phase ki velocity poochi gayi hai.
Diya kya hai? Aakhri phase mein 60 km, 2 ghante mein; graph par yeh B(3, 100) se C(5, 160) tak ka seedha hissa hai.
Rule: displacement-time graph ka slope hi velocity hota hai.
Plan: BC ka slope nikalna, yani rise ko run se divide karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: aakhri phase \(B(3, 100)\) se \(C(5, 160)\) tak.
Maloom karna: aakhri phase ki velocity.
Tareeqa: displacement-time graph par slope \(dx/dt\) velocity hota hai (7.1.4). Seedhi line ka slope har jagah ek jaisa hota hai, is liye is poore phase mein velocity constant (uniform) hai.

BC ka slope
\[v = \dfrac{160 - 100}{5 - 3}\]
\[= \dfrac{60}{2} = 30\text{ km/h}\]
Kyun: slope = rise / run, yani displacement mein tabdeeli ko waqt mein tabdeeli se divide kiya. Upar 60 km ka farq aur neeche 2 ghante ka farq.
Dhyan dein: yahan 160 ko 5 se divide nahi karna; woh poore safar ki average thi. Ek phase ki velocity sirf usi phase ke farq se nikalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[30 \times 2 = 60\text{ km} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 30 km/h ki raftaar se 2 ghante mein theek 60 km bante hain, jo sawal mein diya hai. Muqable ke liye: pehle phase ka slope \(100/2 = 50\) km/h tha aur stop AB ka slope 0, kyunke line horizontal hai.

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 7.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
